scope: Search of all seven proposed source families; curated additions and a separate full Reactor folder inventory. Not an exhaustive crawl of the public web. Follow-up: official Blackmagic product, support, training, SDK and forum resources checked on 2026-09-06. Follow-up on 2026-09-07: selected unmatched Greenysmac entries and related creator products checked against primary listings; per-entry review dates are retained. Follow-up on 2026-09-07: five directory repositories scanned (118 text files); 35 selected primary-verified additions, including 18 Akascape listings. The scan is not a claim that every outgoing link is verified.
